# Tagcast 1.9.8

This release adds Vinyl to the expanded player, brings ListenBrainz to artist
discovery and makes large libraries easier to browse.

## Expanded playback

- Choose **Vinyl** alongside **Cover** and **CD**. The record turns behind the
  sleeve and its tonearm follows track progress, including when you seek.
  The choice is remembered locally and respects reduced motion.
- Three new fullscreen visualizations are available: **MilkDrop · Ember Tunnel**,
  **MilkDrop · Kaleido Bloom** and **Stereo · Vectorscope**.
- Some MP3 streams that otherwise cannot seek can now use a temporary in-memory
  buffer. Experimental Gapless playback requires Premium and **Original file**.

## Discover and tidy your library

- **Similar in your library** uses ListenBrainz by default when you have no
  saved choice. It needs no account or API key and falls back to local genres
  when it cannot find useful matches. Last.fm and local-only discovery are
  still available under **Settings → Discovery**.
- **Overview → Metadata health → Artist cleanup** lists possible missing
  guest credits by album, such as an artist named in a `feat.` track title.
  Each result opens the existing track editor for review.
- Changing album sort order returns to the start of the results, including in
  continuous scroll. The album selection actions stay visible beneath the
  browse controls while albums are selected.

## Settings and reliability

- **Library & editing** groups metadata and multi-disc options. The combined
  album warning is highlighted when it applies. **Data & files** houses
  uploads, exports and trash review. A dismissed library information banner
  stays hidden.
- Large queues and playlists reuse more loaded data. Temporary library reload
  failures preserve the current view and playback, and Queue Sync handles
  remote play, pause and position changes more reliably.
